title: Launch playbook
description: The product launch film, 15 to 90 seconds: five story shapes (problem-first, demo-first, manifesto, metric-first, category-creation) with the selection rule, peak placement by kind of film (an early reveal, or a name reveal plus a later outcome peak), frame-budgeted beat sheets for 15, 30, 45 and 60 seconds with VO word budgets, the reveal and hero-shot craft measured from GenMotion's launch templates, the music or VO sound plan, social proof rules and recuts per destination. Load it for a product, app or company launch video.
summary: Five launch shapes, peak placement by film type, frame-budgeted beat sheets for 15–60 s, VO budgets, sound plan and recuts per destination.

requires.why: Narration for VO-led shapes: problem-first, demo-first and metric-first.
A build-and-drop track with the drop on the reveal.
Hits on the reveal and the mark, clicks on presses.
Real product screenshots, recordings and the logo file; without screens, a representative UI labelled illustrative, never an invented logo.
The product's real copy, palette and claims from its site.
The first-frame, mute and reveal checks are made on captured frames.
Measuring the export's loudness and building a contact sheet.

route.deliverable: A 15–90 second product launch film: hook, the proposition by beat 2, a reveal, proof on the product, and a held end card
askFirst: What is the product, and the one thing it does that the alternative can't?
Where does it run first (landing page, Product Hunt, X, LinkedIn, TikTok), and with sound or muted?
What real material is there: screens or a recording, the logo file, a true number?

models.note: Only for a manifesto or category shape's invented visuals, never a product shot.
